description: Create one private saved opportunity search with the supplied name and criteria. Requires authenticated workspace access and explicit user intent. Creates an account workspace if needed and adds a search without replacing existing searches. Returns a private feed link. The first successful check establishes a baseline; no email or external notification is sent.

active.description: Filter by source active status; this does not mean the response deadline is open.

after.description: Last notice ID from next_after in the preceding page.

agency.description: Agency code on the source notice.

generation.description: Retained generation UUID from a prior result for a consistent snapshot.

limit.description: Maximum notices to return, from 1 to 50; defaults to 25.

naics.description: Two- to six-digit NAICS industry code from a notice or the NAICS reference collection.

q.description: Plain-language keywords; empty returns notices matching the other filters.

set_aside.description: Official set-aside code from a notice or the set-asides reference collection.

state.description: State or territory code for the place of performance.

criteria.description: Opportunity filters to save; generation, after and limit are reset by the server.

name.description: Human-readable name for the new saved search; 1 to 100 UTF-8 bytes after trimming.

name: create_saved_search

feed_path.description: Private capability path; do not share it publicly.

message.description: First successful check establishes a baseline, not delivered changes.

title: Create a saved search
